title: Is There a Wallet App Across Asian Countries That Pays Your Electricity and Internet Bills?
summary: Picture an envelope on the shoe rack of a Mont Kiara condo in Kuala Lumpur. Inside is the month's electricity bill in ringgit, with a QR code in the corner.
body_markdown:
Picture an envelope on the shoe rack of a Mont Kiara condo in Kuala Lumpur. Inside is the month's electricity bill in ringgit, with a QR code in the corner. The fibre router blinks next to the TV, and the internet invoice sits in your inbox.


Can one wallet pay both? Not quite. No single local wallet is accepted everywhere in Asia, because each country's bills run on its own national QR network:[DuitNow QR](https://moretapay.com/networks/duitnow) in Malaysia,[QR Ph](https://moretapay.com/networks/qr-ph) in the Philippines,[VietQR](https://moretapay.com/networks/vietqr) in Vietnam,[KHQR](https://moretapay.com/networks/khqr) in Cambodia. What does exist is a wallet that connects to several of those networks at once. Moreta builds that kind of wallet. Moreta Pay pays electricity, water, internet and phone bills by QR in the markets where it runs on the local rail, as long as the provider offers a QR payment on a supported network. You top up in your home currency, and the utility receives local currency.


**About the Author:**


This guide is written by the team at Moreta, the Y Combinator-backed company behind Moreta Pay, a wallet that pays national QR networks across Asia and Latin America, including utility bills on those networks. Moreta Global Inc. is a FinCEN-registered Money Services Business.


## Why isn't there one wallet that pays bills in every Asian country?


Each country built its own national QR standard, and the domestic banks and wallets in that country use it for utility bills. Malaysia has DuitNow QR. The Philippines has QR Ph. These networks are national by design, so a "pan-Asian" wallet has to connect to each one separately.


Regional apps do exist, but they are built for a different job. Dash, the Singapore wallet Western Union bought from Singtel in 2026, advertises


[overseas bill payment](https://dash.com.sg/topup/obp)


, so users can pay electricity, TV and telecom bills for their families in countries like India and the Philippines. That helps someone sending support home. A visitor paying the bill for the apartment they live in this month is a different scenario.


## How is a QR code bill payment different from paying at a shop?


Because bills run on those national rails, understanding what a bill QR actually carries matters. A QR code bill payment encodes structured reference data that a shop QR does not need.


Think of a shop QR as a till. It only needs to know who gets paid and how much. A bill QR works more like a pre-filled deposit slip. It also carries your customer account number or invoice ID, so the utility's system knows whose meter to credit.


Swipe for more


Shop (merchant) QR Bill (biller) QR


What it encodes Merchant identifier, amount Biller identifier, amount, your account or invoice reference


Where it settles At the counter, immediately Against your account in the provider's system


What you check Merchant name, amount Biller name, amount, that the bill is yours


This explains a common mistake. Paying the utility's generic shop-style QR, or typing an amount into a bank transfer with no reference, can leave the payment unmatched to your account. Pay the QR printed on your own bill.


## Can foreigners use GCash or other local wallets to pay bills?


The obvious workaround is to download the wallet locals use. That is where most visitors stop. Domestic wallets are built around local identity.


- **GCash**


registration typically asks for a local mobile number.


Requirements change, so check each provider's current rules. The bill QR does not care which app scans it, as long as that app is connected to the national network. In the Philippines, Moreta Pay pays QR Ph codes directly. You do not need a GCash account to pay a QR Ph bill. One caveat: a code labelled for a single wallet may not be a QR Ph code, so look for the QR Ph mark.


## How do you pay an electricity or internet bill with Moreta Pay?


Once the bill carries a code on a supported network, the steps mirror paying at a hawker stall. We covered the counter version in our


[Malaysia guide to DuitNow QR](https://moretapay.com/blog/apps-like-duitnow-qr-for-foreign-travelers-in-malaysia)


at a mamak.


1. **Top up from home.**


You can use US ACH, SEPA (EUR), UK Faster Payments (GBP), Canadian Interac e-Transfer, a Visa, Mastercard, American Express or Discover card, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or USDC/USDT on Solana. Stablecoin-funded balances cannot be spent in Cambodia or China.


2. **Find the QR on the bill.**


It may be on paper, in a PDF opened on a laptop, or on the provider's web checkout. Check for DuitNow QR, QR Ph, VietQR, KHQR,[QPay](https://moretapay.com/networks/qpay) or[Seoul Pay](https://moretapay.com/networks/seoulpay) .


3. **Scan and read the screen.**


Before you confirm, Moreta Pay shows the biller name, the amount in local currency, the exact FX rate and the fee.


4. **Slide to pay.**


The utility receives local currency. Save the receipt, which shows the merchant name, merchant ID and payment number. It is your proof if the building manager asks.


Bill payments carry the same per-payment fee as any other Moreta Pay payment. Each country also has a maximum single payment and a weekly limit, shown in the app before you pay. Check them before a large quarterly bill.


## When do you still need cash or a bank transfer?


A QR-first approach covers a lot, but not everything.


- Some building managers in Phnom Penh or Ulaanbaatar still collect utilities in cash. In Cambodia that can mean riel or US dollars, depending on who is collecting.


- Autodebit arrangements are typically set up from a local bank account.


- Some providers offer no QR at all, only domestic transfer or a payment counter.


Keep a modest reserve, such as a couple of 50 MYR notes in Kuala Lumpur, for the bill that refuses to be scanned. If you pay an internet bill online with a foreign card and the portal offers to charge you in your home currency, decline it. That is dynamic currency conversion. Always choose to pay in local currency.


## Is Moreta Pay built for business bills?


Separate from personal utilities is the question of company expenses. Moreta Pay is a consumer wallet for travelers, expats and digital nomads. It is not a tool for B2B cross-border payments. If you need to pay an office lease or supplier invoices on behalf of a company, look at products built for business payments.


## What should you set up before your first bill arrives?


- **Verify your account early.**


Moreta Pay checks identity with a selfie and your passport. Do it before the bill is due.


- **Get an eSIM.**


Scanning needs a data connection at the moment you pay.


- **Ask your landlord one question:**


"Does the bill have a DuitNow QR (or QR Ph, KHQR) code?" The answer tells you whether you need any cash at all.


## Frequently Asked Questions


### Is there one app that pays bills in every Asian country?


No. Bills settle on national QR networks. The practical choice is a wallet connected to several of them.


### What is the best pay electricity bill app for a foreigner?


Use one that pays your country's national QR without asking for a local account. Moreta Pay does this in markets including Malaysia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos, Mongolia and South Korea.


### Can I pay bills in Singapore with Moreta Pay?


No. Singapore is not a supported market, and PayNow and SGQR are not Moreta rails.


### Can I pay bills in China?


Only if the provider offers a[WeChat Pay](https://moretapay.com/networks/wechat-pay) code. Moreta Pay pays WeChat Pay codes, not Alipay's, and only while you are physically in China. Stablecoin funding is not available for China due to local regulations; you can top up with card, bank transfer, or Apple Pay/Google Pay instead.


### What if the bill has no QR code?


Moreta Pay cannot pay it. Use the provider's counter, your landlord's preferred method, or cash.


### Where is my money held?


Funds are held by banking partners. Moreta Global Inc. is a FinCEN-registered Money Services Business.
